# Photon mass attenuation coefficients mu/rho, in units of cm^2/g, per element.
#
# NIST Standard Reference Database 8: XCOM Photon Cross Sections Database
# (doi: 10.18434/T48G6X). Total attenuation with coherent scattering, on XCOM's
# standard grid from 1 keV to 20 MeV plus each element's absorption edges, for
# Z = 1 to 100. An edge is two points at the same energy: the first holds the
# value below the edge, the second the value above it.
#
# XCOM serves this through a query form rather than as a download, so the table
# was transcribed from the copy OpenMC ships (MIT licensed) rather than fetched.
# tools/fetch_dose_data.py holds it against an independent NIST tabulation, the
# SRD 126 per-element tables, which cover Z = 1 to 92 on a coarser grid: of the
# 3311 energies the two share, only two disagree by more than 1%, the worst
# being 2.49% at Z = 87 at 1 keV.
#
# One line per element, packed the way packages/yamc-core/python/yamc/data holds its other bulk
# tabulations rather than one line per point:
#
#     Z <atomic number> <n> <n energies, eV> <n coefficients, cm^2/g>
MASS_ATTENUATION
